newsitem.title: FRANCE: Minister does not exclude France T'com sale.
newsitem.headline: Minister does not exclude France T'com sale.

text.p: French secretary of state for industry Christian Pierret suggested in an interview with daily Liberation on Thursday that at least part of the capital of France Telecom might be opened up.

He said that "with (Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn), we fixed three aims -- to reinforce France Telecom's strength as a big European telecoms opeator, guarantee its independence and allow it to attain critical mass on a world scale".
"All this," he told the newspaper, "implies at least a minimum opening to the world of (financial) markets."
